title: MAKIEVAL: A Multilingual Automatic WiKIdata-based Framework for Cultural Awareness Evaluation for LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with open-ended generation tasks across culturally salient topics (e.g., food, books, clothing), extracting cultural entities using an LLM, linking the entities to Wikidata, and calculating metrics for granularity, diversity, culture specificity, and culture consensus to measure cultural awareness across regions.

Comparing the cultural entities generated by LLMs across 13 different prompt languages to evaluate cross-lingual disparities, observing how the prompt language itself (especially English versus non-native languages) influences the diversity, specificity, and granularity of the cultural knowledge produced.
